title: SDKs: surface overload error codes + Retry-After cleanly (Python/TS/Go)
creator: Monica Patel
description:
Goal
Surface new overload protection semantics (Redwood overload reason codes + Retry-After guidance) as first-class, ergonomic error fields in our Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs.

Context
As part of Hosted circuit breakers + load shedding, the API will return deterministic overload responses (primarily 429/503) with:
- A Redwood-specific overload reason code (stable enum)
- Retry guidance via Retry-After header (seconds or HTTP-date)
- Consistent error body shape (including OpenAI-compat endpoints)

SDKs need to:
1) Preserve backwards compatibility for existing exception types as much as possible
2) Provide a typed/structured way to detect overload vs other errors
3) Make Retry-After easy to consume (parsed into seconds + raw header)

References
- Initiative: ENG-4821 (Hosted circuit breakers + load shedding)
- Standard error payload/schema: https://github.com/redwood/pr-18433 (shared error-code enum + JSON schema)
- Gateway mapping behavior: ENG-4823
- OpenAI-compat mapping: https://github.com/redwood-openai-compat/pr-188
- Public docs update (for parity checks): https://github.com/redwood-docs/pr-912

Requirements / Acceptance Criteria
Cross-SDK
- All SDKs expose:
  - overload: boolean (true when HTTP status in {429,503} AND Redwood overload reason is present)
  - redwood_error_code: string (exact enum value as returned by API)
  - retry_after_seconds: integer | null (best-effort parse of Retry-After)
  - retry_after_raw: string | null
  - http_status: integer
  - request_id: string | null (from x-request-id or equivalent)
- Ensure OpenAI-compat endpoints map into the same SDK error fields (no special-case needed by customers).
- Do NOT treat overload responses as “success” or silently retry in the SDK by default.
- Provide helper for recommended retry/backoff pattern (docs/snippet) that uses retry_after_seconds when present and otherwise uses exponential backoff with jitter.
- Unit tests for:
  - Retry-After numeric seconds parsing
  - Retry-After HTTP-date parsing (clamp negative to 0)
  - Missing header (retry_after_seconds=null)
  - Non-overload 429 (quota/rate limit) does not incorrectly set overload=true unless Redwood overload reason present

Language-specific implementation notes
Python
- Extend existing APIError (or RedwoodError) to include:
  - .redwood_error_code
  - .retry_after_seconds
  - .retry_after_raw
  - .is_overload (property)
- Ensure __str__ includes a single-line hint when is_overload is true: “Overloaded; consider retrying after N seconds” (avoid verbose multi-line logs).
- Add docs example showing safe retry loop w/ jitter.

TypeScript
- Extend error type (e.g., RedwoodAPIError) with typed fields above.
- Add helper function (exported) like isOverloadError(err): boolean and getRetryAfterSeconds(err): number | null.
- Avoid breaking changes to existing narrowing patterns (instanceof checks).

Go
- Add new error type or wrap existing one:
  - type APIError struct { StatusCode int; RedwoodErrorCode string; RetryAfterSeconds *int; RetryAfterRaw *string; RequestID string; ... }
- Ensure errors.Is / errors.As work to extract APIError.
- Add example in docs for exponential backoff + honoring Retry-After.

Out of scope
- Implementing automatic retries in the SDK (we may add an opt-in client retry policy later).
- Changing billing behavior or quota semantics.

Rollout plan
- Land SDK changes behind normal semver patch/minor (no behavior change unless overload fields present).
- Validate with canary region where overload protection is enabled (us-east) by replaying synthetic overload responses (recorded fixtures).
- Coordinate with DevEx/docs (ENG-4832) so public guidance matches SDK surface area.

Notes / Edge cases to handle
- Retry-After header can be integer seconds OR HTTP-date.
- Some proxies normalize header casing; treat case-insensitively.
- Ensure we don’t incorrectly mark “429 rate_limit_exceeded” (quota) as overload; overload should be keyed off Redwood overload reason code (per ADR/error taxonomy).

Deliverables
- Python SDK PR merged and released
- TypeScript SDK PR merged and released
- Go SDK PR merged and released
- Changelog entries mentioning new overload fields
- Minimal examples in docs / README per SDK

Linked PRs
- Python: https://github.com/redwood-sdk-python/pr-522
- TypeScript: https://github.com/redwood-sdk-typescript/pr-418
- Go: https://github.com/redwood-sdk-go/pr-301

QA checklist
- [x] Fixture-based tests for 429/503 overload variants
- [x] Verify OpenAI-compat response maps into same fields
- [x] Ensure non-overload 4xx/5xx unchanged
- [x] Confirm request-id is surfaced for support workflows
comments: 2025-12-06 (Monica Patel): Please align field names across SDKs. We should not force customers to parse headers manually; Retry-After should be first-class. Also ensure OpenAI-compat path gets the same ergonomics.

2025-12-09 (Ibrahim Khan): Drafted common parsing behavior: Retry-After numeric seconds OR HTTP-date. Will implement best-effort parse; if date parses to past, clamp to 0. If invalid, set retry_after_seconds=nil but keep retry_after_raw.

2025-12-11 (Brian Murphy): Reminder: overload vs rate limit must not be conflated. For 429, check Redwood overload reason presence; quota/rate-limit 429 should keep overload=false even if Retry-After is set by gateway.
2025-12-17 (Ibrahim Khan): Python PR up (redwood-sdk-python#522). Added APIError.is_overload and fields. Included tests for header parsing + request-id extraction.
2025-12-19 (Monica Patel): TS should keep instanceof RedwoodAPIError working. Avoid changing constructor shape. Please add helper isOverloadError(err) for ergonomics.
2026-01-03 (Ibrahim Khan): TS PR up (redwood-sdk-typescript#418). Added typed fields + helpers. Kept existing error class; fields are optional unless present on response.
2026-01-07 (Ibrahim Khan): Go PR up (redwood-sdk-go#301). Implemented APIError struct updates + errors.As support. Added example retry loop honoring Retry-After with exponential backoff fallback.
2026-01-12 (Allison Grant): Quick telemetry note: request-id surfacing helps correlate customer logs with breaker state snapshots. Thanks for adding x-request-id extraction across SDKs.

2026-01-20 (Monica Patel): All three SDK PRs merged. Please ensure changelog notes mention 'Retry-After parsing + overload reason codes' and point to docs guidance. Marking ticket done after releases cut.
2026-01-22 (Ibrahim Khan): Released python/ts/go packages. Verified against canary overload fixtures: overload=true only when Redwood overload code present; Retry-After parsed as expected.
